CustomField.description: Ticked: bill and estimate totals are shown to the paisa. Unticked (the default): totals are rounded to the nearest rupee, shown as a "Round off" line. Stated this way round so companies that existed before the setting round off too: a new checkbox leaves existing records unticked whatever its default (architecture.md §F). Applied when a document's lines are saved (BillTotalsService, EstimateTotalsService), so older documents keep their totals.
CustomField.label: Exact Totals (No Round Off)
